UTF-8 expected decoding uses strict CLR/Rune logic and an independent C Unicode scalar decoder, compared with Rust std::str plus actual bounded detail. Both valid and invalid outcomes occur.

Ownership paths allocate through actual Rust creators, inspect usable results, compensate conversion/reserve/publication/adoption failures and observe final owner/backing/capacity counts.

Positive usable results and recoverable cleanup are present. SafeHandle-only post-Dispose admission, duplicate live notification and the isolated numeric-oracle perturbation make named guards observable.
schedule_review: Actual per-instance lifecycle hooks cover four admitted-lease boundaries and four compensation faults; physical reference retirement is observed separately from logical closure.
Seven async setup/start/cancel/copy/take barriers, two root-construction faults and pre-canceled synchronous registration exercise the actual bridge.

Exactly six action permutations times four drain positions times three native outcomes run in each mode. A held native source lease and independent control lease prevent Task completion from being mistaken for reclamation.
Actual native callback admission/stop, active handler charging, pending discard, synchronous handler fault/reentrant close and four actual coordinator mailbox wake positions are covered.

Thread and queue counts describe the selected controlled actors; runtime timer/ThreadPool/GC internals are not claimed to be exhaustively controlled. Optional A08 executor worker joins are explicitly separate.
